Maria A (AE): Quick heads-up — prospective global bank asking for a sealed on-prem POC. Key asks: no outbound egress, signed boot media, offline license activation, quarterly upgrades but patch window every ~8 weeks, and they want a pricing floor if we do custom airgap packaging. Can SE + Security advise on feasibility and rough pricing?

Sam T (SE): We can support sealed bundles. Two approaches: full image (USB) or chunked delta bundles. Delta reduces transfer size but requires chunk-level signature verification. For POC I'd recommend chunked 50MB chunks + a signed manifest (ed25519) so they can verify each piece offline. We have a helper script: `redwood-airgap-package --chunk-size 50M --signer=<key>`.

Jordan C (Security): SOC2 report and pen test available. They also want SBOM + SLSA attestation level 1. Need to confirm HSM/offline KMS story: do we ship signing creds or integrate with customer HSM? Also they asked about certificate revocation without egress — how do we handle CRLs or revocation semantics?

Alex R (EngOps): Practical stuff: we can provide an offline signing tool that works with customer HSMs via PKCS#11 (YubiKey / HSM appliance). For customers that cannot expose HSM, we can sign on their behalf under strict custody but that triggers legal/data controls. For revocation, we can ship signed revocation lists as part of delta bundles; instantaneous revocation without network access is hard — we should document tradeoffs.

Priya (Sales-PS): Pricing question: they expect a one-off "airgap packaging & integration" fee + an annual private runtime/support fee instead of pure per-token. Also they want the POC to be 6 weeks total. Can we ballpark numbers to include in SOW?

Sam T (SE): Ballpark: engineering integration + packaging automation ~ $35k–$60k depending on HSM adapter complexity. One-off image creation and testing ~ $10k. Annual private runtime + 24x7 support for a small dedicated environment (POC scale) starting around $150k/yr. These are scoping numbers — we'll firm up after tech discovery.

Maria A (AE): Action items: Jordan to draft security answers for their questionnaire; Alex to confirm packaging/runtime and the offline signing flow; Sam to produce a minimal POC checklist and a smoke-test script; Priya to include pricing lines in draft SOW. Target: start POC in 6 weeks.

Jordan C (Security): I'll fill the SIG and add notes about offline pentest expectations. Also recommend they run an internal network pentest; we can provide our latest pen test summary under NDA. They asked about encrypted container formats — I suggest `age` for simple key exchange or CMS for enterprise; will note both.

Alex R (EngOps): Upgrade cadence details: our default is quarterly majors + hotfixes. For this customer propose an 8-week patch cadence for POC, with emergency hotfixes offered on a 48-hour SLA provided they supply the offline activation credentials and handle the physical install of signed artifact. We'll need a "delegation of trust" and a signed acceptance checklist.

Sam T (SE): Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) offline deploy from signed bundle + manifest verification 2) smoke tests pass (latency median <300ms on their infra) 3) model output parity within 95% of our baseline eval set 4) offline license activation completes and metering enforces POC token cap (they want 100k tokens/month). I'll draft the smoke-test script and an eval checklist.

Priya (Sales-PS): Commercial: include clause that any packaging changes beyond initial agreed scope billed T&M. Also flag export control — bank operates with EU branches and wants crypto to be EU-approved; legal to confirm. They also asked for invoice milestones tied to delivery windows.

Maria A (AE): FYI they specifically asked for per-chunk CRC32 verification plus manifest signature and an option for USB shipping. Sam — can we simulate a "sneakernet" install in our POC checklist? Also add rollback playbook for hotfix fails.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Note: staging airgap image build scheduled for 2024-04-02 03:00 UTC (artifact id: a1b2c3).

Sam T (SE): :thumbsup: I'll own the sneakernet checklist and attach `airgap-poc-checklist.md` to the SOW draft (will include CRC checks, manifest verify steps, and USB handling notes).

Jordan C (Security): :white_check_mark: Starting the SIG and will include SBOM + SLSA notes plus pen test summary.

Alex R (EngOps): :raised_hands: Will verify HSM adapter compatibility with PKCS#11 by EOD Friday and confirm whether we need additional hardware for the customer.

Priya (Sales-PS): :moneybag: I'll draft the pricing lines and a two-option commercial (one-off packaging + annual support vs. premium reserved capacity) and send to Maria.

Maria A (AE): :memo: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate notes and update the SOW. Next sync Wednesday 10am PT. Please confirm availability.

Maria A (AE): final note: customer also asked for an "offline eval mode" that enforces a 100k-token/month cap for the POC and a sandbox license key that expires after 30 days. Sam — can we simulate metering serverless (i.e., offline metering that reconciles after connect) for the demo? Add the reconciling steps to the runbook.

Sam T (SE): We can simulate metering by embedding a periodic offline ledger in the agent that records token usage and verifies signature upon reconnection. Add to checklist: `agent --offline-ledger --max-tokens 100000` + reconciliation procedure.

Maria A (AE): Great — thanks. I'll loop Legal for export control + signing custody language.
